title: BYPASS Adonis AC
script:
--metod 1 stable for hooks and more...
local g = getgc(true)
for i = 1, #g do
    local t = g[i]
    if type(t) == "table" then
        local s, r = pcall(rawget, t, "indexInstance")
        if s and type(r) == "table" and r[1] == "kick" then
            setreadonly(t, false)
            for k, d in next, t do
                if type(d) == "table" and d[1] == "kick" then
                    setreadonly(d, false)
                    d[2] = function()
                        return false
                    end
                end
            end
            pcall(rawset, t, "tvk", {"kick", function() return false end})
        end
    end
end

--metod 2 stable but 30sec frezee game 
local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local oldN
oldN = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(s, ...)
    if getnamecallmethod() == "Kick" and s == lp and not checkcaller() then return end
    return oldN(s, ...)
end)

for _, v in ipairs(getgc(true)) do
    if typeof(v) == "table" then
        local d, k = rawget(v, "Detected"), rawget(v, "Kill")
        if typeof(d) == "function" then
            hookfunction(d, function(m, ...)
                if m ~= "_" then warn("[A] D:" .. tostring(m)) end
                return true
            end)
        end
        if typeof(k) == "function" and rawget(v, "Variables") then
            hookfunction(k, function(...)
                warn("[A] K")
                return
            end)
        end
    end
end
